RT POKT Network
On June 3rd at 10AM PT, Pocket Network will perform a hard fork upgrading to the 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗡𝗡𝗢𝗡 𝗠𝗔𝗜𝗡𝗡𝗘𝗧 👏
The Morse version of the network will be archived for lookup & be deprecated, w/ relevant network parameters set to 0, and traffic being redirected to the Shannon mainnet. Check out the FAQs & comment your questions! 🤝
https://pocket.network/shannon-upgrade-faq/
